name: shoot-8793
about: 8793 preloaded with 8 in its ALLIANCE ZONE in TELEOP: the turret swings round on its motor against its energy chain, the flywheel's velocity loop spins to SHOT_TABLE's speed, the hood follows the aim, the turret indexer feeds its load up the bore into the shooter and over into the HUB (scored), with its jam recovery and the unjam as the shot stops; then it drives out past the zone line, its arm comes down, it intakes and shuttles what it picks up back (M3c).
